# France to become Eramet’s top shareholder via miner’s capital hike

[Reuters](/external-author?external_author=Reuters) | October 12, 2026 | 10:49 am  [Battery Metals](https://www.mining.com/category/battery-metals/) [Critical Minerals](https://www.mining.com/category/critical-minerals/) [Europe](https://www.mining.com/region/europe/) [Lithium](https://www.mining.com/commodity/lithium/) [Manganese](https://www.mining.com/commodity/manganese/) [Nickel](https://www.mining.com/commodity/nickel/)

![](https://www.mining.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Eramet-Grande-Cote-1024x576.jpg)

Since 2014, Eramet Grande Côte has been extracting and processing mineral sands on a concession that stretches over a hundred kilometers along the Atlantic coast north of Dakar. Credit: [Eramet](https://grande-cote.eramet.com/en/eramet-grande-cote/)

France is set to become Eramet’s (EPA: ERA) largest shareholder by increasing its stake during a €500 million ($558.50 million) capital increase later this year, the French mining group said on Monday.

Nickel, manganese and lithium producer Eramet had announced in February it would conduct a capital hike to help recover from a slump in earnings and a jump in debt.
